cause: take() mutated position_ in one emit() argument while another read it. Windows evaluated the end position first, producing a one-character == span; Parser.cpp selected its >= fallback. The fixed lexer computes the token kind before reading the final position for ->, =>, == and !=. This is a pre-existing frontend sequencing bug, not a division-arithmetic or tail-return bug.
coverage: Exact token spans and comparison AST kinds, adjacent/spaced operators, LF/CRLF; full native Windows downloaded-package acceptance includes signed remainder/GCD and all six integer/floating comparison predicates. The temporary diagnostic workflow is removed after qualification.
